correctness.rationale: Starting from C4, every legal edge or two-edge corner attachment is enumerated and exactly isomorphic duplicates removed; independent replay reproduced 1,2,7,29,179 graph-isomorphism counts. Every generated graph is bipartite; any face of Cliq_5 has at most 8 vertices because any 9-set contains an independent 5-set in one bipartition. Independent full enumeration of each of 179 face posets, greedy toggle matching, exhaustive Hasse-incidence direction/topological sort and critical-cell census reproduced 255,727 nonempty faces, 127,616 pairs and b-distribution 67,27,34,16,2,33. Each acyclic matching leaves one critical vertex and b critical 7-cells, so Forman’s theorem gives an integral wedge of b S^7. This is exhaustive at exactly five squares; not extrapolated to all lengths.
